<!-- GitHub contribution entry point for Frigate's native platform; the root guide belongs to the decomp. -->
# Contributing to Frigate

For Frigate builds, platform code, tests and documentation, follow the
[Frigate contribution guide](https://github.com/CallanCampos/Frigate/blob/main/port/CONTRIBUTING.md).
Submit port pull requests to **CallanCampos/Frigate:main** from a topic branch in your personal fork.

The root CONTRIBUTING.md describes decompilation work. That work belongs to the separate decomp project and reaches
Frigate through maintainer sync. Port issues and discussion stay in this repository.
